# Risk register

Owner: Head of Engineering, Example Ltd
Last reviewed: 2026-03-01

Identified risks for the service desk ticket ranking system.

| Risk | Mitigation | Residual risk |
|---|---|---|
| Biased ranking of tickets | Quarterly fairness review | Low, accepted |
| Model drift after retraining | Release gate on evaluation results | Low, accepted |
| Loss of the vendor model service | Exit plan and fallback ranking rules | Medium, monitored |
